description: List content keys (HTML/md); not assets — use list_assets. Defaults to 50 keys per page: raise limit (max 1000) or pass cursor (nextCursor). Per-row `size`/`missing` are measured only on pages of ≤100 rows; past that they're ABSENT (never `null`) unless you pass withSize:true (one storage read per row). Only `size: null` + `missing: true` means the page's bytes are gone.

cursor.description: Resume from a prior response's nextCursor.

guestToken.description: Guest token from start_site (pgg_…). Omit when signed in with OAuth.

withSize.description: Force size/missing measurement on a page bigger than 100 rows (costs one storage read per returned row). Default false — rows in a ≤100-row page are measured either way.

name: list_content
